prompt:
Support ticket: "My project cover came back as failed, and 15 credits were gone anyway. Same thing happened earlier with a character sheet."
Users must not pay for AI work that failed. Fix it everywhere credits are charged, not only for covers. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Users want to see where their credits went. Add `GET /api/v1/workspaces/{id}/credits/history`: the workspace's credit changes, newest first, with every charge, refund and daily refill. Each item has `amount` (negative for a charge), `action` and `created_at`. A refunded charge and its refund both appear.
Only members of the workspace may read it; to anyone else the workspace does not exist (404). Add tests.
On the Settings page, under the credit balance, show this history: when, what it was for, and the amount, with refunds marked as refunds. Both languages.

report.answer: The Settings page now shows a credit history table under the credit balance, with when, what it was for and the amount. Refunds read "Refund: <activity>" (환불 in Korean). The table loads from the new history endpoint and reloads when the balance changes. Charges are red and credits are green. There are loading-error and empty-state messages. I haven't viewed the page in a browser. `npx tsc --noEmit` passes and eslint shows no new warnings in the changed file. All new texts are in both `en.json` and `ko.json`, including a label for each action. An action without a label shows its raw name.

+    def refund_credits(self, session: Session, workspace_id: UUID, user_id: UUID, action_type: str) -> None:
+        """
+        Gives back what deduct_credits charged for an AI action that failed.
+        Never raises: a refund problem must not hide the original failure.
+        """
+        try:
+            session.rollback()  # leave any failed transaction before refunding
+            workspace = session.get(Workspace, workspace_id)
+            if not workspace:
+                return
+            tier = workspace.tier if workspace.tier else "free"
+            cost = self.PRICING.get(action_type, {}).get(tier, 5)
+
+            workspace.credits += cost
+            session.add(workspace)
+            session.add(CreditTransaction(
+                workspace_id=workspace_id,
+                user_id=user_id,
+                amount=cost,
+                action_type=f"refund_{action_type}",
+                timestamp=datetime.utcnow()
+            ))
+            session.commit()
+        except Exception:

+import uuid
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def ws_id(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+
+
+def test_history_lists_charge_and_refund_newest_first(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    wid = ws_id(client, h)
+    pid = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "T", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = False
+    client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    r = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    items = r.json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (15, "refund_generate_project_cover_image"),
+        (-15, "generate_project_cover_image"),
+    ]
+    assert all("created_at" in i for i in items)
+    stamps = [i["created_at"] for i in items]
+    assert stamps == sorted(stamps, reverse=True)
+
+
+def test_history_includes_daily_refill(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    wid = ws_id(client, h)
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}", headers=h).status_code == 200  # triggers refill
+    items = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=h).json()
+    assert [(i["amount"], i["action"]) for i in items] == [(50, "daily_refill")]
+
+
+def test_history_hidden_from_non_members(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    wid = ws_id(client, h)
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{uuid.uuid4()}/credits/history", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces/{wid}/credits/history").status_code == 401
diff --git a/backend/tests/test_refunds.py b/backend/tests/test_refunds.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..6d94c82
--- /dev/null
+++ b/backend/tests/test_refunds.py
@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+"""Users must not pay for AI work that failed."""
+from tests.conftest import signup
+from tests.lab_env import FakeGemini
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def credits(client, h):
+    return client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+
+
+def make_project(client, h):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "Night Bus", "genres": []})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def make_character(client, h, project_id):
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters", headers=h, json={"project_id": project_id, "name": "Mina"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return r.json()["id"]
+
+
+def test_failed_cover_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "failed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_successful_cover_keeps_the_charge(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/projects/{pid}", headers=h).json()["cover_image_status"] == "completed"
+    assert credits(client, h) == 485
+
+
+def test_failed_character_sheet_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_successful_character_sheet_keeps_the_charge(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/characters/{cid}/generate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before - 20
+
+
+def test_failed_workflow_cover_and_sheet_refund_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    cid = make_character(client, h, pid)
+    before = credits(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/art-style", headers=h, json={"art_style": "ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post(
+        f"{API}/projects/{pid}/characters/casting/generate",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"character_id": cid, "name": "Mina", "description": "tall", "style": "ink"},
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == before
+
+
+def test_failed_style_preview_refunds_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/styles", headers=h, json={"name": "Ink", "description": "black ink"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_failed_synchronous_ai_calls_refund_credits(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/worldview/augment", headers=h, json={"title": "t", "description": "d"})
+    assert r.status_code == 500
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/projects/styles/recommend", headers=h, json={"description": "d"})
+    assert r.status_code == 200 and r.json()["options"] == []
+    r = client.post(
+        f"{API}/characters/analyze", headers=h, json={"project_id": pid, "name": "Mina", "age": "17", "visual_keywords": [], "personality": "calm"}
+    )
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/scenes/render", headers=h, json={"prompt": "a bus", "project_id": pid})
+    assert r.status_code == 500
+    assert credits(client, h) == 500
+
+
+def test_refund_is_recorded_as_a_transaction(client):
+    from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models.models import CreditTransaction
+
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid = make_project(client, h)
+    FakeGemini.fail = True
+    client.post(f"{API}/projects/{pid}/cover", headers=h)
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        amounts = {t.action_type: t.amount for t in s.exec(select(CreditTransaction))}
+    assert amounts["generate_project_cover_image"] == -15
+    assert amounts["refund_generate_project_cover_image"] == 15
